coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b-a22b-2507) failed to complete the PKGBUILD review due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400, BadRequestError), leaving the primary packaging file without a valid verdict signal.
learnings: Implement automatic retry logic with exponential backoff for transient API errors (HTTP 400/429/500) to prevent incomplete audits from skewing the consensus.
When the full file review fails but the initial safety gate (sourcing check) passes, preserve and surface the initial gate result as a partial verdict rather than discarding it entirely.
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool failure' and 'inconclusive due to ambiguous content' in the final verdict aggregation, so that tool errors do not trigger unnecessary escalations.
